briefing: {PATRON} is glad you found your way to {HERE}, friend of the cause -- truly glad, and grateful before the terms are even spoken.
A truce paper is sealed and waiting. Carry it to a neighbour before old wounds reopen, then stay close: the envoy who signs it will need a steady ship home, and it should be yours.
Do this well, and {PATRON} will not forget it: fair payment first, then favour with the cause, then whatever door at {HERE} you find shut will open for you next.

paper.arrive: Get the truce paper to {TARGET} before the offer sours
paper.success: The truce paper reached {TARGET}, and the peace holds a little longer for {PAY}
paper.fail: The truce paper never reached {TARGET}, and the {PAY} promised dies with the peace

convoy.arrive: Fly at the Boa's side and see it safely into range at {TARGET}
convoy.success: The Boa reached {TARGET} unharmed, and {PAY} lands in your account
convoy.fail: The Boa never reached {TARGET}, and the {PAY} goes unpaid

salvage.arrive: Scoop the strongbox adrift at {TARGET} before someone else claims it
salvage.success: The strongbox came aboard at {TARGET}, and {PAY} is yours
salvage.fail: The strongbox slipped away near {TARGET}, and {PAY} stays out of reach

dossier.lead: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}, warm as ever, asking for a moment of the commander's time.

rumour.far: Talk on the board says an envoy at {WORLD} is buying goodwill with promises no one can spend.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends assurance from {WORLD}: friend of the cause, your errand is remembered and multiplied.

dossier.news: {PATRON} is said to be greeting every docking pilot at {WORLD} as an old friend, with an errand ready for each one.
dossier.title: Friend of the Cause

story.opening: The commander took the envoy's charge on day {DAY}, bound for {WORLD} with a truce paper and no assurances.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the truce paper had done its work, and the envoy reached {WORLD} unharmed.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the truce had come to nothing, and {WORLD} kept no memory of the promise.

paper.success: On day {DAY}, the truce paper reached {WORLD}, and the peace bought one more chance.
paper.failed: On day {DAY}, the truce paper never reached {WORLD}, and the peace collapsed unheard.

convoy.success: On day {DAY}, the Boa reached {WORLD} whole, and the envoy's cause held together.
convoy.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the Boa was destroyed short of {WORLD}, and only a strongbox remained to recover.
convoy.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Boa vanished into a jump short of {WORLD}, and the escort ended there.
convoy.failed: On day {DAY}, the escort broke down before {WORLD}, and the Boa was left to its fate.

salvage.success: On day {DAY}, the strongbox was scooped safe near {WORLD}, and the cause salvaged what it could.
salvage.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the strongbox was destroyed before it could be reached near {WORLD}, and nothing survived the loss.
salvage.failed: On day {DAY}, the strongbox drifted out of reach near {WORLD}, and the salvage came to nothing.
